methods.note: The paper's method is a closed-loop STREAM controller (ANN stress, MTTF/LTDP lifetime banking, lifetime MPC, DVFS) on a two-layer TSV 3D IC with a transient synthetic workload (pp.4-9, 12-13). The extraction's own physical_mismatches mark five essential mismatches and steady_2d_relevant=false. Yet experiment.kind is 'custom_2d_steady'. That is a 2D steady reproduction claim for a 3D, transient, controller-dependent result, so it is contradicted.

code.note: The paper gives no repository or availability statement. The packet has no pinned assets, and the extraction reports only 'checked_no_links'. The MATLAB R2016b implementation, ANN weights, MPC and lookup-table code are not available. No evidence supports reproducing the controller.

parameters.note: Verified in the text: chip 10x10x0.3 mm (p.9), ambient 20 C and ri/ro of 20/24 um (p.10), 90 C threshold and ~110 C free run (p.12), ~240 s deposit exhaustion (p.13). Missing: A0, qc, sigma0, B0, Ea, na, MTTFth, Np, Nc, the MPC lookup-table entries, the synthetic workload power amplitudes, and any numeric Fig. 14a/14b series. The 0.3 mm thickness is ambiguous (total or per layer). The text-derived 110 C is a statement, not a visually verified figure value.

config.note: The paper does not publish a HotSpot-3D configuration: layer thicknesses and materials, TSV coordinates, interface material, package, heat sink or convection. Nothing from the Studio package or material assumptions was supplied. Only the 92-node model dimensions (p.11) are given.

data.note: There are no per-block geometry coordinates (Fig. 4a is a graphic only) and no same-scenario per-block power rows for the synthetic workload; floorplan and power_w are empty. There are no pinned assets and no numeric time series. Fig. 14a/14b were not visually verified: the evidence is pdftotext output only, and only a few text scalars were checked. The decisive figures are unverified.

findings.reason: The extraction sets 'custom_2d_steady' although the paper observable is a transient maximum temperature on a two-layer TSV 3D IC under DVFS/MPC feedback. This contradicts the extraction's own steady_2d_relevant=false and the essential mismatches. Calling it a 2D reproduction is unsupported.
findings.locator: extraction.experiment.kind vs extraction.scenario.steady_2d_relevant and physical_mismatches; paper pp.9-13

findings.reason: The floorplan is empty and there are no same-scenario power rows. Block geometry and power are required for any 2D reproduction and cannot be supported from the paper.
findings.locator: extraction.experiment.floorplan=[], power_w={}; evidence power_rows and block_geometry_x_y_width_height; Fig. 4a p.6

findings.reason: The 110 C value comes from the text, not from verified Fig. 14a content. No visual check of the figure is documented, no time series exists, and the aggregation is a transient. It cannot be treated as a paper observable for a steady 2D model.
findings.locator: pdf p.12 Section V-D and Fig. 14a

findings.reason: The 240 s value is text-only ('around 240 s'), and Fig. 14b was not visually verified. The paper text on p.13 also says the deposit is 'always larger than 0 according to Fig. 14b' while saying it is fully consumed at ~240 s. This is an unresolved ambiguity needing the figure.
findings.locator: pdf p.13 Section V-D; Fig. 14b p.12

findings.reason: The paper gives 0.3 mm for a chip made of two identical layers. Whether this is total or per-layer thickness is unspecified, so the normalized 0.0003 m is not unambiguous.
findings.locator: pdf p.9 Section V first paragraph

findings.reason: No code or data assets were found or supplied. Controller, ANN and workload inputs are not independently reconstructable.
No package or material assumptions were supplied or recorded, and the paper gives no HotSpot-3D package or material config. The config check cannot be resolved.
The MTTF model constants, MTTFth, MPC horizons and the synthetic workload power trace are not in the paper. The reliability and controller dynamics are therefore not reproducible.
